does: Wakes what stands near one anchor point: asks the level's spatial grid for the cells within the largest radius, activates items within the item radius (or the low-item radius) and, when the anchor is a party member, characters within the character activation radius that the per-character rule left waiting; things within the deactivation radius are taken out of the to-sleep set.

evidence.says: radii from the manager's +0xD0/+0xD4 (characters 40/45), +0xD8/+0xDC (items 40/45), +0xE0/+0xE4 (low items 10/15) chosen by its sixth argument; the character branch runs only when its fifth argument (HasComponent<eoc::party::MemberComponent> of the anchor) is set; a caret's position replaces a patrolling character's

called once per tick per anchor (101 calls in 3 s with one party member, 2 per tick with a second anchor); a sleeping creature moved to 39 m from the party member is woken by SetActive called from +0x41A6C52 inside it, one at 40.5 or 42.5 m is not; a ForceSynch character without party membership woke no character 8 m away, the same character given a party member component and put into the party view woke characters 8 and 20 m away
EoCServer.dll exports this name; it is tied to this function by the job its read shows
